 Home » Nation CBSE Releases 2027 10th, 12th Board Exam Time Table
 Nation DC Web Desk 7 Nov 2026 7:10 PM IST 7 Nov 2026 7:10 PM IST The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027. The examinations for both classes will begin on 16th February next year, with papers commencing at 10:30 AM.
 x Representational Image As Preferred
Source New Delhi: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has announced the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations for 2027.As per the schedule, examinations for both classes will begin on February 16, with all papers starting at 10:30 AM.Class 10 exams will conclude on March 9, while Class 12 exams will continue till April 9. 
 According to the board, Class 10 students will appear for exams in 83 subjects, while Class 12 students will take exams across 121 subjects.Students have been advised to check the detailed subject-wise timetable on the official CBSE website. 
 The Board said the date sheet had been prepared after carefully considering more than 40,000 subject combinations to ensure that students do not face any clashes between examinations in the subjects they have opted for. Earlier, the Board had also announced the schedule for practical examinations and internal assessments for the 2026-27 academic session.
 CBSE Class 10 examinations 2027 Time Table
 For schools across India and abroad, practical examinations and internal assessments for Classes 10 and 12 will be conducted from 1st January to 13th February next year. However, for winter-bound schools, practical examinations will be held earlier, from 9th November to 19th December this year.
 More than 26.5 lakh students are expected to appear for the Class 10 board examinations, while over 19.8 lakh students will take the Class 12 examinations.
